name: How much does an ADU feasibility consultation cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does an ADU feasibility consultation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for an ADU feasibility consultation varies based on the complexity of your property and the depth of analysis required. Some companies offer a basic review, while others provide a more comprehensive report including preliminary cost estimates. We can provide a clear quote once we understand your specific location and project scope within our service areas like Fremont or Pleasanton.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consultation costs vary by property complexity and analysis depth. We provide quotes based on location and project scope.
